items.title: Threat of AI share crash puts world financial stability at risk, says IMF
items.summary: High valuations and debt put sector in danger, while fund also warns on government borrowing and cyber-attacks IMF warns global economy ‘could soon test the limits of resilience’ The threat of an AI share price crash rippling out across global markets is putting world financial stability at risk, the International Monetary fund has warned. In its twice-yearly Global Financial Stability Report, the IMF highlighted the sky-high valuations for AI companies along with their increasing debt pile as one reason that risks in the system are “elevated”. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 国际货币基金组织：人工智能股票崩盘威胁全球金融稳定
items.summaryZh: 国际货币基金组织警告称，人工智能领域的高估值和债务积累正威胁全球金融稳定。该机构指出，全球经济可能很快面临韧性极限的考验，政府借贷和网络攻击风险也在增加。
items.whyImportant: 此警告凸显了当前科技行业泡沫对全球宏观经济潜在的系统性风险。

items.title: Hong Kong group aims to cultivate a lasting future for rural Lantau communities
items.summary: Many rural projects in Hong Kong start with funding, run for a year or two, then disappear when the money runs out. Good Old Soil, a community organisation, is trying to take a different approach on Lantau. Supported by the non-profit Land Education Foundation, the organisation works with farmers, young people, restaurants, craftspeople and businesses to build a local economy that can sustain itself after individual grants end. Founded in 2022, Good Old Soil opened a shop in Mui Wo that same...
items.titleZh: 香港团体旨在为大屿山农村社区培育可持续未来
items.summaryZh: 社区组织“好土”通过与农民、青年及企业合作，试图在大屿山建立一个不依赖短期资助的自给自足经济模式。该组织在梅窝开设了店铺，致力于实现农村项目的长期可持续发展。
items.whyImportant: 该模式为香港农村社区的长期发展提供了新的探索方向。

items.title: China-US astronomy team may have found possible relic of a recent ‘gold factory’
items.summary: A mysterious glow of high-energy light in our Milky Way galaxy could be the remains of an extremely rare cosmic “gold factory”, according to a new study by Chinese and US researchers. The collision of two orbiting neutron stars – dead stars so dense that a teaspoon of their matter would weigh a billion tonnes – may have shone as brightly as Jupiter in the sky, they wrote in a paper posted last week on the preprint server arXiv, which has yet to be peer-reviewed. The violent smash spewed out...
items.titleZh: 中美天文学家团队可能发现了近期“黄金工厂”的遗迹
items.summaryZh: 中美研究人员在银河系中发现了一处高能光芒，这可能是罕见的“黄金工厂”——中子星碰撞的遗迹。该研究指出，此次碰撞产生的亮度极高，相关论文已在预印本平台发布。
items.whyImportant: 这一发现有助于科学家进一步理解宇宙中重元素的起源。

items.title: Ex-Cyberport department head, 5 others, charged over HK$20 million tech subsidy fraud
items.summary: A former department head of Hong Kong’s fintech hub Cyberport has been granted bail after being charged with accepting bribes to help an artificial intelligence (AI) start-up secure HK$20 million in funding from a government-subsidised programme. Alice So Nga-lai, 59, former head of entrepreneurship of the Hong Kong Cyberport Management Company, was accused of receiving advantages such as flight tickets, one handbag, two tote bags, one coin purse and a mobile phone between October 2023 and...
items.titleZh: 前数码港部门主管等6人因涉嫌2000万港元科技补贴欺诈被控
items.summaryZh: 香港数码港前创业组主管苏雅丽被控收受贿赂，协助一家人工智能初创公司骗取2000万港元政府补贴。目前她已获准保释，案件涉及多项财物贿赂。
items.whyImportant: 此案揭露了政府资助项目在监管方面存在的潜在漏洞。

items.title: Watch: What could Trump's energy ceasefire mean for Ukraine?
items.summary: The BBC's Dan Johnson reports from Kyiv, where Ukrainians face another winter with electricity outages.
items.titleZh: 视频：特朗普的能源停火协议对乌克兰意味着什么？
items.summaryZh: BBC记者丹·约翰逊从基辅发回报道，当地乌克兰人正面临又一个电力中断的冬天。该报道探讨了特朗普提出的能源相关政策可能对乌克兰局势产生的影响。
items.whyImportant: 此议题涉及地缘政治变动对乌克兰能源安全及战时民生的潜在影响。

items.title: Thailand’s deepening labour shortage roils harvest as unpicked fruits rot
items.summary: Ripe mangosteen and rambutan hang unpicked from trees in eastern Thailand, where a shortage of migrant workers is forcing growers to decide which crops are valuable enough to harvest and which will be left to rot. For Jomsak Putirattana, who also grows durian in Chanthaburi province, the departure of his five Cambodian workers after a border dispute disrupted crossings has intensified competition for labour. Daily wages have more than doubled in some cases, from about 350 baht to 400 baht (US$10...
items.titleZh: 泰国劳动力短缺加剧，导致农作物无人采摘腐烂
items.summaryZh: 泰国东部因外籍劳工短缺，导致山竹和红毛丹等水果无人采摘而腐烂。边境争端导致劳工流失，使得当地农场主面临工资成本飙升和作物损失的双重压力。
items.whyImportant: 劳动力短缺问题正直接威胁泰国的农业生产和出口经济。

items.title: Not just about tax: why Australia’s tech entrepreneurs are moving to Singapore
items.summary: Investor Ben Lindsay relocated from Sydney to Singapore in March, with wife and dog in tow – his sights set on growing venture capital firm Investible from an Australian outfit into an Asia-Pacific one. Lindsay is among a growing number of investors, businessmen and tech founders from down under who are setting up bases and relocating to Singapore, Dubai and San Francisco to expand their company’s reach. For example, Australian billionaire Adrian Portelli, founder of savings and rewards platform...
items.titleZh: 不仅仅是税收：为什么澳大利亚科技创业者纷纷迁往新加坡
items.summaryZh: 越来越多的澳大利亚投资者和科技创业者选择迁往新加坡、迪拜或旧金山，以寻求更广阔的亚太市场。除了税收因素外，企业寻求国际化扩张是推动这一人才流动的核心动力。
items.whyImportant: 这一趋势反映了澳大利亚科技行业在寻求全球化发展过程中面临的本土市场局限性。

items.title: Breaking Bad actor RJ Mitte dies aged 34
items.summary: Actor who played Walter White Jr on the acclaimed show and advocated for disability representation remembered by Bryan Cranston as ‘my sweet son’ RJ Mitte – a life in pictures The actor RJ Mitte, whose personal experience living with cerebral palsy informed his role as Walter White Jr in the landmark television series Breaking Bad, has died aged 34 in Brownsville, Texas. “It is with profound sadness that we share the tragic passing of beloved actor, philanthropist, and passionate disability rights advocate RJ Mitte,” Mitte’s representatives said in a statement. “Drawing from his own experience living with cerebral palsy, Mitte brought authenticity to the role and built a platform on disability awareness and inclusion.” Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 《绝命毒师》演员RJ·米特去世，享年34岁
items.summaryZh: 曾在知名剧集《绝命毒师》中饰演小沃尔特·怀特的演员RJ·米特在得克萨斯州去世，年仅34岁。他本人患有脑瘫，在剧中展现了真实演技，并长期致力于倡导残疾人权利与包容性。
items.whyImportant: 该演员的离世引发了影视界对其在残疾人代表性方面所做贡献的缅怀。

She is an incredible person, someone that I have so much respect for, and being able to come home was incredible. Just the emotion that it brings is, you can’t describe it. I mean, it’s been years. items.titleZh: 澳大利亚政治直播：气候抗议者扰乱新南威尔士州议会；阿尔巴尼斯誓言阻止美国执行死刑直播
items.summaryZh: 一名气候抗议者在新南威尔士州议会中断会议后被制服。此外，获释回国的澳大利亚工程师罗伯特·佩瑟讲述了他在伊拉克被监禁五年的经历，并坚称自己无罪。
items.whyImportant: 该报道涵盖了澳大利亚国内的抗议活动及备受关注的公民海外获释事件。

items.title: Card surcharge ban used as ‘cover’ for larger price increases by Australian businesses, experts say
items.summary: ‘Round-up’ pricing in items such as coffee suggests increases are exceeding the typical 1.5% surcharge fee Follow our Australia politics live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Businesses are using the recent ban on credit card surcharges as “cover” to pass along much larger price increases to customers, experts say, as cafes and restaurants struggle to cope with climbing costs and rising interest rates. Credit card surcharges, typically worth about 1.5% of the transaction, were banned from 1 October, as part of a Reserve Bank-led reform aimed at improving transparency for customers and, ultimately, lowering bank fees. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 专家称澳大利亚企业利用信用卡附加费禁令作为涨价“掩护”
items.summaryZh: 自10月1日起，澳大利亚禁止收取信用卡附加费，旨在提高透明度并降低费用。然而专家指出，咖啡馆和餐馆正利用此机会进行远超原附加费比例的涨价，以应对经营成本上升。
items.whyImportant: 这一现象反映了政策改革在实际执行中可能产生的通胀转嫁效应。

items.title: Hurricane Simon and Tropical Storm Rachel kill five people on Mexico’s Pacific coast
items.summary: Security forces use helicopters to rescue dozens of people as the two storms damage infrastructure and cause flash flooding At least five people have died after Hurricane Simon and Tropical Storm Rachel pummelled Mexico’s Pacific coast, causing flooding that downed trees and electricity poles, blocked roads and inundated homes. Simon claimed the life of a 71-year-old man who died when a wall collapsed in Chilpancingo in the southern state of Guerrero, governor Evelyn Salgado said at a press conference. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 飓风“西蒙”和热带风暴“雷切尔”袭击墨西哥太平洋沿岸，造成五人死亡
items.summaryZh: 飓风“西蒙”与热带风暴“雷切尔”接连袭击墨西哥太平洋沿岸，引发洪水并导致基础设施受损。目前已造成至少五人死亡，救援人员正利用直升机疏散受灾民众。
items.whyImportant: 极端天气事件对当地民众生命安全及基础设施造成了严重破坏。

items.title: Nato ‘ready to fight tonight’ if attacked, top commander says
items.summary: Nato’s top military commander said the alliance is “ready to fight tonight” if it is attacked, as European officials warn Russia could test Nato’s defences with increased covert attacks or a limited military incursion. European nations have in recent months faced an escalation of covert Russian activity, including an arson attack on an Estonian defence company and a failed attempt to attack a Ukrainian aircraft at a German airport. If Russia decides to attack Nato, the alliance will respond by...
items.titleZh: 北约最高指挥官称若遭攻击已“准备好今晚开战”
items.summaryZh: 北约最高军事指挥官表示，面对俄罗斯可能进行的隐蔽攻击或有限军事入侵，北约已做好随时应对的准备。近期欧洲多国已发生多起针对国防设施的破坏活动。
items.whyImportant: 此表态显示了北约在当前地缘政治紧张局势下对防御能力的强调。

items.title: RJ Mitte, Breaking Bad star and disability rights advocate, dies at 34
items.summary: RJ Mitte, the young actor best known for playing Walter White Jnr in the award-winning TV series Breaking Bad, has died, his representatives said on Monday. He was 34. The cause of death for the actor, who lived with cerebral palsy, was not immediately revealed. “It is with profound sadness that we share the tragic passing of beloved actor, philanthropist, and passionate disability rights advocate RJ Mitte,” said a statement issued by Sean Reilly. A teenage Mitte first appeared in Breaking Bad...
items.titleZh: 《绝命毒师》演员及残疾人权利倡导者RJ·米特去世，享年34岁
items.summaryZh: 曾在《绝命毒师》中饰演小沃尔特·怀特的演员RJ·米特去世，享年34岁，死因尚未公布。他不仅是一位演员，还是一位积极的残疾人权利倡导者。
items.whyImportant: 该演员的离世引起了公众对其演艺生涯及社会公益贡献的广泛关注。

items.title: Middle East and Central Asia’s economy to shrink in 2026 amid war, IMF says
items.summary: Iraq, Bahrain, Kuwait and Qatar face double-digit declines in GDP amid the fallout from the US-Israel war on Iran.
items.titleZh: 国际货币基金组织：受战争影响，中东和中亚经济将在2026年萎缩
items.summaryZh: 受美国与以色列针对伊朗的战争影响，中东和中亚地区的经济前景恶化。伊拉克、巴林、科威特和卡塔尔的国内生产总值预计将出现两位数下滑。
items.whyImportant: 地区冲突对全球能源供应及区域经济稳定构成了严重威胁。

items.title: Selma Blair charged with assault of police officer and nurse after allegedly attacking flight attendants
items.summary: Actor, who allegedly punched one Delta attendant, bit another and tried to open plane door, was charged for two separate assaults after the plane landed The actor Selma Blair was arrested on Sunday at John F Kennedy airport in New York after she allegedly attacked two flight attendants on a Delta Air Lines flight, and separately charged with two counts of assault for allegedly kicking a police officer and a nurse after landing. Blair’s arrest happened at about 11pm, after Port Authority of New York and New Jersey officials said they responded to a call “about a physically abusive passenger aboard Delta Air Lines flight 938 which was parked at the gate” at JFK after arriving from Los Angeles. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 塞尔玛·布莱尔因涉嫌袭击空乘人员、警察和护士被控
items.summaryZh: 演员塞尔玛·布莱尔在达美航空航班上涉嫌袭击空乘人员，并在飞机降落后因踢伤警察和护士被控两项袭击罪。布莱尔在纽约肯尼迪机场被捕，目前正面临相关法律诉讼。
items.whyImportant: 该事件引发了公众对航空安全及名人行为规范的关注。

items.title: Cyberattack on French supermarkets causes fires, millions in losses
items.summary: A cyberattack targeting supermarket refrigeration systems has left shelves empty across France.
items.titleZh: 法国超市遭网络攻击，导致火灾及数百万损失
items.summaryZh: 针对法国超市制冷系统的网络攻击导致全国范围内货架空置。此次事件造成了严重的经济损失及火灾隐患。
items.whyImportant: 此事件凸显了关键基础设施在网络攻击面前的脆弱性。

items.title: Why Haidilao’s US$14.9 million credit line to founder is fuelling China tax speculation
items.summary: Haidilao International Holding has agreed to provide its founder, Zhang Yong, with a one-month loan of up to the Hong Kong dollar equivalent of 100 million yuan (US$14.9 million), a move that has raised market speculation as investors closely watch Beijing’s October 22 deadline for offshore trust taxation. The Hong Kong-listed hotpot chain said in a stock exchange filing on Monday night that it would fund the loan from internal resources and charge interest at 0.6 percentage points above the...
items.titleZh: 海底捞向创始人提供1490万美元信贷额度为何引发中国税务猜测
items.summaryZh: 海底捞向创始人张勇提供约1亿港元的短期贷款，正值市场密切关注北京离岸信托税收政策截止日期之际。此举引发了投资者对税务合规及资金用途的广泛猜测。
items.whyImportant: 该贷款行为引发了市场对企业高管税务安排及监管合规性的讨论。

items.title: Therapy dogs in high demand: Hong Kong programme booked out until February 2027
items.summary: A Hong Kong therapy-dog programme run by one staff member and 65 volunteers with their dogs is fully booked until February 2027, as demand from schools, hospitals and elderly homes continues to outstrip the available visiting slots. Animals Asia’s Dr Dog and Professor Paws programmes rely on volunteers who give up their time, shoulder much of the cost of transporting their dogs and return regularly to venues across the city. “None of it would be possible without the volunteers,” said Karina...
items.titleZh: 治疗犬需求激增：香港项目预约已排至2027年2月
items.summaryZh: 香港的治疗犬项目因学校、医院及养老院需求巨大，预约已排满至2027年2月。该项目完全依赖志愿者及其犬只的无偿服务。
items.whyImportant: 这反映了社会对动物辅助治疗服务的需求日益增长。

items.title: Bullet hole in door and DNA evidence scrutinised in Beau Lamarre-Condon double murder trial
items.summary: Defence also cross-examines witness over postmortem examinations of Jesse Baird and Luke Davies Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast A bullet hole left in a bedroom door and DNA found in the barrel of the firearm have been scrutinised in court as Beau Lamarre-Condon’s double murder trial continues in Sydney. Lamarre-Condon, 31, has been accused of fatally shooting Jesse Baird and Luke Davies with his police service weapon in Baird’s Paddington home on 19 February 2024. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 悉尼双重谋杀案审判：法庭审查门上弹孔及DNA证据
items.summaryZh: 在博·拉马尔-康登的双重谋杀案审判中，法庭对卧室门上的弹孔及枪管内的DNA证据进行了详细审查。被告被控使用警用武器杀害了两名受害者。
items.whyImportant: 此案因涉及现役警察作为被告而受到社会高度关注。

items.title: Same-sex couple sue over Slovakia’s refusal to register marriage
items.summary: Case of couple who wed legally in Austria exposes clash between EU court ruling and national restrictions A same-sex couple are suing authorities in Slovakia for refusing to register their Austrian marriage, testing whether a landmark EU court ruling can turn recognition abroad into legal security at home. Their fight exposes a clash between European obligations and national restrictions – and what that means for LGBTQ+ people living under Robert Fico’s populist-nationalist government. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 同性伴侣起诉斯洛伐克拒绝承认其婚姻登记
items.summaryZh: 一对在奥地利合法结婚的同性伴侣因斯洛伐克拒绝承认其婚姻而提起诉讼。此案旨在测试欧盟法院的裁决能否在斯洛伐克国内产生法律效力，凸显了欧盟义务与该国保守政策之间的冲突。
items.whyImportant: 该案件将考验欧盟法律在成员国国内对LGBTQ+权益保护的强制执行力。

items.title: Tuesday briefing: Could Burnham take Britain back towards the EU?
items.summary: In today’s newsletter: The prime minister is calling for closer ties with the EU, but what could this actually amount to? Good morning. After a holiday spent contracting nursery bugs from an 11-month-old, it’s good to return. Yesterday, Andy Burnham marked his first day back after party conference by calling for a closer relationship with the EU and drawing a line under a decade of “drift and division”. On Sunday, he said it was “clear” the Kremlin had been involved with the 2016 Brexit referendum vote. Both statements mark a break, rhetorically at least, from his predecessors. Conservative governments long insisted there was no evidence of Russian interference in the Brexit vote. Keir Starmer attempted to put the entire issue of Brexit behind him, treating it as a historic event rather than a cause of economic pain. items.titleZh: 周二简报：安迪·伯纳姆能否带领英国重返欧盟？
items.summaryZh: 英国政界人士安迪·伯纳姆呼吁与欧盟建立更紧密的关系，并指责克里姆林宫干预了2016年脱欧公投。这些言论标志着英国政府在对欧政策及对俄立场上可能出现重大转变。
items.whyImportant: 英国对欧政策的潜在调整将对未来的英欧关系及地缘政治格局产生深远影响。
